about.title: About the project
items: Digital library, version 0.2.4
Project created for KGKU "Khabarovsk Center for Social Support of the Population"
Developers: Sokolov Mikhail Andreevich, Razuvaev Sergey Alexandrovich

intro.title: 1. About the system
items: The digital library provides access to the organization's document catalog.
Catalog, news, and document pages open after sign-in. Without an account the site shows the login page.

browse.title: 2. Browsing the catalog
items: After sign-in, Home shows the list of sections and documents.
Open a section to see subfolders and files.
Click a document to view it in the built-in viewer.

citizen_categories.title: 3. Citizen categories
items: The Citizen categories item in the menu shows a catalog of categories — a convenient way to find materials by target audience.
Pick a category to see linked catalog folders you are allowed to open.
Open a folder to browse documents the same way as in the main catalog.

login.title: 4. Signing in
items: If there is no session, or it has ended, the login page opens.
When self-registration is enabled by the administrator, the login page offers a Create account link.
After a successful login, sections appear according to your assigned role.
If registration is disabled and you do not have an account, contact a system administrator.

about.title: About the project
items: Digital library, version 0.2.4
Project created for KGKU "Khabarovsk Center for Social Support of the Population"
Developers: Sokolov Mikhail Andreevich, Razuvaev Sergey Alexandrovich

intro.title: 1. Getting started
items: After sign-in the working interface opens. When the session ends, the site returns to the login page.
On the left is the menu of sections your role can open. On top are search, the ? button (this help), the bell, the light/dark theme switch, and the user menu.
The sidebar button in the header collapses or expands the menu.
Dates and times in lists, the news feed, and the audit log use the Vladivostok time zone (UTC+10).

portal.title: 2. Portal and document catalog
items: Home opens the catalog: a list of folders and documents, a path trail, and an optional section tree. Turn the tree on with Show folder tree.
Click a folder to open its contents and a document to open the viewer.
If your role can use the file browser, the catalog has Manage in file browser. From the browser, Browse in catalog returns to the catalog list.
News is the portal feed: title, text, date, author, and attachments. An attachment opens like any other document.
Users who can manage the feed see Add news and can edit or delete a post. Attachments are picked from the portal tree with Documents….

library.title: 3. Library
items: Library has three tabs: Favorites, Recent, and Trash.
Favorites are materials you starred in the document viewer. You can also remove the star on the Favorites tab.
Recent lists folders and documents you opened, with the view time.
Trash holds deleted materials. Select rows and choose Restore or Delete permanently when your role allows it.
The Trash tab shows how long files are kept. After that they are deleted automatically. Only a superuser can change the period (1 to 3650 days).
The bell in the header lists new feed posts only. You can mark an item read and open the feed.

citizen_categories.title: 4. Citizen categories
items: Citizen categories opens a catalog with a name, short description, and linked folder count.
Pick a category to see folders you are allowed to open.
Open a folder — navigation continues the same way as under Home.
Creating and editing categories and linking folders to them require the matching permissions.

documents.title: 5. Viewing documents
items: The viewer toolbar has the favorite star, Download (when permitted), About file, and, with file-browser permission, split screen.
Split screen opens a second panel with the same material. The arrow copies one panel into the other so you can compare different folders or documents.
The breadcrumb above the document returns to the parent folder.
PDFs and images open in the browser preview. Zoom and text selection, when the file contains text, use that preview.
Word documents (.docx) are shown page by page: you can jump to a page number and change the zoom.
Video and audio play in the viewer. Text files and HTML are shown as text.
Spreadsheets, presentations, archives, and older Word files (.doc) can be downloaded. A detailed preview may be unavailable.
On upload, Word (.docx) and JPG, JPEG, PNG, TIF, and TIFF images also get a PDF copy. Download lets you choose the original or that copy.
The About file panel contains tags, Full file version, a private note, a rating, and comments.
The private note is visible only to you and requires permission to edit materials. The rating is 1 to 5 stars, with the average shown beside it.
Full file version lists attached catalog materials. Documents… is available when you can change that list.

search.title: 6. Search
items: The header search field takes a text query. Enter or the search button opens the results page.
Results include folders and documents. Limit the type to all, folders only, or documents only.
Sort by relevance, title A–Z, or title Z–A.
A result shows its tags. There is no separate tag filter.
When a match inside a document is not on the first page, the page number is shown next to it.
The Go back to library arrow on the results page opens the Favorites tab.

tags.title: 7. Tags
items: Tags group documents and folders by topic.
The Tags menu item shows the catalog: name and description.
You can assign tags in the file browser (one selected item) and in About file when you may pick tags from the catalog.
New tags are created only in the catalog. That is limited to administrators and moderators.

profile.title: 8. Profile
items: The user menu in the top-right corner includes Profile.
In your profile you can change email, first name, last name, and password.
Username and assigned roles are read-only.
Choose Log out in the user menu to end the session.

comments.title: 9. Comments
items: Comments and the rating are in the About file panel of an open document.
You can leave a comment when your role allows it. You can edit and delete your own comments.
Other people's comments can be edited or deleted only with the separate comment-moderation permissions.

about.title: About the project
items: Digital library, version 0.2.4
Project created for KGKU "Khabarovsk Center for Social Support of the Population"
Developers: Sokolov Mikhail Andreevich, Razuvaev Sergey Alexandrovich

users.title: 1. User management
items: Users opens the account list.
Create adds a user: username, email, first name, last name, and an initial password.
Select one row to edit the account, change the password (Change Password), or delete it. Several rows can be deleted together.
The account form assigns one or more roles. Roles decide which menu sections and catalog actions are available.
Clear Active to block sign-in and keep the data. Superuser opens the audit log, backup, and the trash retention setting.

roles.title: 2. Roles and permissions
items: Roles lists every role. A role can be created, edited (its permissions), and deleted.
Built-in roles are shown as Administrator, Moderator, and Employee.
Employee can browse the catalog and feed, download documents, pick existing tags, comment, and rate. That role cannot change the catalog, publish news, write private notes, or manage users.
Administrator and Moderator receive the full application permission set. The audit log and backup stay limited to the superuser.
The permission tree includes Citizen categories: view, create, update, delete, and assign folders.
Separate permissions control viewing and editing the Full file version block.
For a new role, grant only the permissions that are needed.

tags.title: 3. Tag catalog
items: In Tags you create, edit, and delete tags: name, description, and the Pinned flag.
Users who may select tags assign them from the catalog and cannot create new ones.
Before deleting a tag, check that it is no longer needed. Deletion removes the tag from documents and folders.

portal.title: 4. Portal and news feed
items: The catalog is edited in the file browser, not in the Home list: use Manage in file browser.
In the browser you can Upload, create a New Folder, and drop files from the computer into the current folder.
On Feed, Add news creates a post with a title, text, and attachments. An existing post can be edited or deleted.
Attachments and Full file version are chosen with Documents… from the portal tree.

commander.title: 5. File manager
items: The file browser opens from Manage in file browser in the catalog. The bottom of the list has page numbers and a page size.
When nothing is selected: Upload, New Folder, and, if you can create folders, Create MSP template.

Create MSP template adds a folder named by you, with the sections «1. Прием документов», «2. Назначение», and «3. Информационный материал», plus the nested folders inside them. If a folder with that name already exists, the template is not created.
One selected item: Change title, tags, and Visibility. For one folder, the users-group icon assigns citizen categories.
Delete moves the selected items to trash. Restore and permanent delete are on the Trash tab in Library.
The superuser sets how long trash is kept on that same tab.
The sort icon orders the list by title, type, modified date, or created date, ascending or descending. Quick search keeps name matches in the list.
Arrange turns on a manual order. Start from the current sort, then drag individual folders and files. Done saves the order for everyone; Cancel leaves without saving.
To move items, drag them onto the target folder and confirm the dialog.
Word (.docx) files and JPG, JPEG, PNG, TIF, and TIFF images get a PDF copy on upload. Rotating, deleting, and extracting pages in the viewer is unavailable.

citizen_categories.title: 6. Citizen category catalog
items: Citizen categories opens the catalog. With create permission you can add a category with a name and description.
A row can be edited or deleted. Deleting a category does not delete folders — only the link is removed.
To show a folder in a category, open it in the file browser, select the folder, and click the users-group icon (Citizen categories).
In a category, a user sees only the linked folders they are allowed to open.

visibility.title: 7. Document and folder visibility
items: Visibility is available when one item is selected and you can change it.
Modes: Inherit from parent folder, Owner and moderators only, Everyone (including guests), and Selected roles only.
For Selected roles only, pick the roles. An icon next to the name in the list shows the current mode.
Items set to Inherit take the level of the nearest parent folder that has an explicit mode. If none is set, the material stays restricted.
A superuser can see materials regardless of the mode. The site still opens only after sign-in: Everyone widens access under the visibility rules and does not replace an account.

backup.title: 8. Backup
items: Backup in the menu is available only to the superuser.
Export everything builds a portable archive: the database (users, roles, permissions, documents, folders, news, citizen categories, settings) and every uploaded file.
The archive is saved as papermerge-backup.pmgbackup. Keep the tab open until the export finishes.
Restore from archive replaces the current database and files with the selected archive. Make a fresh copy and confirm before restoring.
Database address, media path, and the token signing secret are not carried over. Users may need to sign in again after import.

audit.title: 9. Audit log
items: Audit log in the menu is available only to the superuser.
The table shows time, user, action, resource type, identifier, and detail.
It records sign-in and sign-out, views and downloads, search, catalog changes, tags, visibility, comments, ratings, notes, favorites, users, roles, and feed posts.
A long history is split into pages.
